item.title: What Does Womanhood Look Like In The Middle East In 2026?
item.description: Forget everything you think you know. For International Women's Day, Bazaar Arabia asked women from Muscat to Riyadh, Dubai to Casablanca to answer a simple question: what does it actually mean to be a woman in the Middle East right now? The results are a compelling portrait of power, ambition, faith, restraint, visibility and choice. No simplification.
